title: Network meta-analysis in the browser: a tool validated against the R package netmeta
description: The allmeta NMA app (validated at allmeta commit 6e753c6) and a one-command validation against the R package netmeta 3.7-0 on all 13 datasets netmeta ships (364 studies, 52 multi-arm). The app fits common- and random-effects (DerSimonian-Laird) network meta-analysis of study contrasts with multi-arm studies handled, refuses incomplete or inconsistent multi-arm studies as netmeta does, and reports the league table, normal or t-based CIs, prediction intervals, Q, tau^2, I^2 with its CI, the design-based decomposition of Q, and P-scores. Across 26 analyses (13 datasets, two CI methods) the app agrees with netmeta on all 26: 24 within 1e-9 and the same 2 refusals; 410/410 checks pass. Includes the corpus builder, R reference analyses, the engine runner, the analysis that regenerates the article's tables, figures and statistics with a PASS/FAIL check of every number, a Docker image (canonical environment: R 4.6.0, netmeta 3.7-0, Node 24.15.0) and CI on Linux, Windows, macOS and Docker. Earlier app versions had known issues, fixed in allmeta PR #78 (see CHANGELOG.md).
